assets: the program and unit plans and the unit map (units/)
the structure check and its trailers
the coordinator's queue and the lanes' claims
boundaries: a session that claims a unit and the lane that owns it
a pull request body and the structure check that reads it

threats.statement: A session works a unit another lane owns, or a body carries an approved trailer with no review of that head.
A plan is ticked by hand instead of by real commits, so a ready pull request hides an undelivered item.
A unit or a companion file is claimed by two units, so nobody can tell who owns a change.

A plan, a brief or an intake copies a secret or a person's data into the repository. Residual: the secret scans find a secret by its shape; no check finds a person's data, so that half rests on whoever writes the record.
A change touches the units of several lanes, so the queue cannot place it and blocks the lanes behind it.

A planning change edits the structure check itself so its own body passes. Residual: tower/gate runs the structure check from the head it judges (VULN-gate-judged-by-own-head), and the decision the gate-change rule asks for may be any recorded D-NNN.

findings.finding: No check finds a person's data.
Both mitigations run from the head under judgment on GitHub, so a change that edits the structure check judges itself; and any recorded D-NNN satisfies the gate-change rule.
